name: Bastet
subtitle: Daughter of the Sun
description: Unleash the fires of Ra upon your enemies and bathe in the glory of Ra’s Ultimate Power
lore: The goddess of Aaru’s cats—and through them, protector of its people—is discontent with this new world. Ryven’s threats and sheer chaos are threats too great for her to defend against. As such, Bastet reaches beyond the bounds of her realm using her cats as messengers and spies, seeking other like-minded gods to help the ascendance of Order over Chaos.
divinity_generator: Gain [15] Divinity when enemies are damaged by [Blaze].

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%
Awaken the ability: Purifed in Flames

skills.name: Feline Firestorm
skills.description: Attack all enemies with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:blaze-ii] on each target for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: Increase’s this hero and Ra's Divinity by 50 for each [Blaze] placed.

skills.name: Purifed in Flames
skills.description: Increase this hero’s Turn Meter by 5% when inflicting damage to enemies under [mechanic:blaze].
skills.awakening_bonus: Increase the turn meter of all allies instead.

skills.name: Mystical Sistrum
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 3 times. If the target is under [mechanic:blaze], each hit has a 50% chance to increase the duration of [mechanic:blaze] by 1 turn and Heal this hero.

skills.name: Eclipse Reckoning
skills.description: Attack all enemies with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:res-down-i] on each target for 2 turns. If Ra is on team, increase damage inflicted by 25% and place [mechanic:res-down-ii] instead.

imprint_passive: Increase this hero’s Turn Meter by 2.5% when inflicting damage to enemies under [Blaze].
